title: Anchored Hilbert Cube reconnaissance
a1_4_scope: One bounded rational-point closure attempt for the corrected equation-(6) anchor tower only: Weierstrass/descent information for Y^2=z^4-20*z^2+256*z-412, then z^2-4 square, k square, and u^2+4 square reconstruction tests.
hard_stop_condition: After this single bounded A1-4 attempt, terminate StageA1 unless it produces a nondegenerate rational anchored point, a complete rational-point closure of the exact equation-(6) boundary, a new reverse-map/coverage theorem, or a new necessary condition for arbitrary anchored cubes. Do not rotate to unrelated Hilbert-cube families merely to continue the side line.
substantive_progress_requires_one_of: new proved identity or rational-point statement
removal of a genuine anchor-boundary component
strictly enlarged proved coverage of anchored cubes
new necessary condition for arbitrary anchored cubes
exact adapter to an already-proved theorem
firewalls: No family-specific exclusion implies perfect-cuboid nonexistence.

A rational point on the corrected genus-1 quotient is necessary but not sufficient; every reconstruction square-cover and nondegeneracy condition must pass.
The initial -18 coefficient was an audit error and is replaced everywhere in A1-3 by the equation-(6) coefficient -8.
